items.title: Tesla to Invest Over $3 Billion to Expand German Factory in Cybercab Bet
items.teaser: Tesla will add a new facility at its Berlin-Brandenburg factory as the electric-vehicle maker seeks to boost production of its autonomous Cybercab.

items.title: Activist Calls on Landlord Invitation Homes to Sell Houses ‘One at a Time’
items.teaser: Land & Buildings says the company should sell homes and buy back shares after a ban on large investors buying single-family homes threatens to limit its growth.

items.title: Eli Lilly to Buy Calytrix Bio for Up to $1.5 Billion
items.teaser: Calytrix Bio, a privately held biotechnology company backed by JPMorgan Chase, is developing therapies aimed at a group of rare blood cancers.

items.title: Former Buyout Execs Launch Secondaries Firm to Target Hidden-Gem Assets in Asia
items.teaser: Two former buyout executives have launched an Asia-focused secondaries investment firm to target the region’s backlog of long-held private-equity investments.

items.title: Intel Sued by Investors After 29% Stock Plunge
items.teaser: Intel is being sued by shareholders who claim the U.S. chip maker failed to disclose the scale of a slump in personal-computer sales.

items.title: UniCredit’s Commerzbank Bid Gets EU, U.S. Approval
items.teaser: The European Union’s merger regulator approved UniCredit’s bid to take control of Germany’s Commerzbank, clearing a key regulatory hurdle for a takeover that has been two years in the making and previously faced opposition in Berlin.

items.title: Yen Could Strengthen Versus Dollar by Year-End
items.teaser: The Japanese yen was little changed against the dollar, but could appreciate towards year-end, supported by improving economic conditions in Japan, fund inflows and the Bank of Japan raising interest rates, Bank of America forex strategists said.

items.title: EQT Ventures Invests $10 Million in Enterprise AI Company Edra
items.teaser: Move comes after EQT Ventures deployed Edra’s technology at its internal service desk.

items.title: Virgin Media O2 Downgraded by Moody’s on Turnaround Concerns
items.teaser: Virgin Media O2’s credit grade was cut one level by Moody’s Ratings amid continued uncertainty over the timing and pace of the UK telecom’s turnaround efforts.

items.title: GSA, Calpers Buy £600 Million Student Housing Portfolio
items.teaser: Global Student Accommodation and the California Public Employees’ Retirement System bought a majority stake in a portfolio of student dormitories for about £600 million from a UK housing association.
